items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: I’ve noticed like of my old boss, Jason Mraz, he’s a songwriter.

ctx.x: I played with Blood, Sweat & Tears. I may have loved that music and maybe I didn’t but —

There is a balancing act that goes on as a professional musician, depending on your opportunities and your interests. There are some opportunities I’ve had which I’ve had to let go because I just couldn’t sign off. You know I don’t see a place for me in country music. And I had an opportunity to play with a really big, really big country act, and I couldn’t do it. I just — I just thought okay this is crossing the line. And they are great, but you know, so you just make these decisions on a day-to-day basis. But I…
